name: ModelVariant771_HandleRequest
evidence: matching model_variant/variant771_entry.c: the image entry at base + 4 (four ribbons follow four parts of the slot and fade, then a textured fan widens in front of the slot while two flares drift forward and a stack of growing rings of quads and a cone of triangles spreads out and fades, with the ambient light dimming and recovering and the camera shaking); for a non-negative request it selects the config record indexed by the request and packs three texture images, otherwise it runs one frame and returns 0 before the trail start, 4 until the trail end, 1 on the first drawn frame after it, 2 once the end time has passed and 0 otherwise; Model_UpdateSlotControl calls the variant at base + 4 with the request modulo 1000 and then -1 (notes/model-structures.md)
notes: Shared name bound per image in *_symbols.txt instead of a #define remap; the same address in every bound image; the French header-788 and 885 images build it from the same source. HandleRequest names only the request dispatch, not the effect. See notes/overlays/model-variants.md#per-image-symbol-bindings.
